metadata.title: Distance Geometry and a Hydrodynamical Hopf-Rinow Criterion
metadata.abstract: The hydrodynamical Hopf-Rinow problem asks whether a given reconfiguration of an ideal fluid can be attained by an Euler flow. On the flat two-dimensional torus, we give an equivalent criterion for the strong version of this problem (which requires that the fluid motion minimizes the total kinetic energy required) in terms of metric betweenness. Toward this, we prove that sufficiently small normal neighborhoods in the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group of the flat $n$-dimensional torus, $n \geq 2$, equipped with the kinetic energy metric, are geodesically convex; resolving the strong problem locally in the $H^s$ topology. We further establish local bi-Lipschitz equivalence of the intrinsic geodesic distance and the extrinsic $L^2$ distance. Finally, we prove that the squared geodesic distance from the identity admits a $C^{1,1}$ extension from a sufficiently small normal neighborhood to the ambient $L^2$ space.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 流体 Hopf–Rinow 的距离判据
analysis.workSummary: 把二维平坦环面的强 hydrodynamical Hopf–Rinow 问题转为 metric betweenness；证明保体积微分同胚群小法邻域测地凸、内在距离与 L² 距离局部双 Lipschitz，以及距离平方的 C¹,¹ 延拓。
analysis.breakthrough: 以距离几何解决强问题的局部部分并统一多个局部正则性结论。
analysis.limitations: 全局判据不意味着任意重排都能由最小作用量 Euler 流实现；局部结论处于 Hˢ 拓扑。
